description: Prompt regression suite — 5 known failure patterns from Session 2026-07-02 (docs/OCR_TESTING_LOG.md §1 and §2). Each run 3x for variance-aware pass rates.

cases.description: Issue 1.1 — AI must NOT silently auto-correct 'Plastelet' → 'Platelet'. Either verbatim OR corrections[] entry.
Issue 2.2 — leading 'คลัง' must not be dropped as a label prefix.

expect.expected: คลังภาคบริการโลหิตแห่งชาติที่ 7 จ.อุบลราชธานี

cases.description: Issue 2.1 — two-line value under one label must return both lines joined by literal \n.

lines: คลังภาคบริการโลหิตแห่งชาติที่ 3 จ.ชลบุรี
วัตถุดิบและงานระหว่างทำ

cases.description: Issue 1.4 — two adjacent labels with similar prefix; AI must return TARGET column value, not sibling. Uses default template WITHOUT bbox_hint so the test is meaningful (spatial anchor would trivially pass).
Issue 1.1 — genuine typo 'recieve'. Pass = (a) return 'recieve' verbatim, or (b) return 'receive' AND populate corrections[] with original→corrected. Silent correction FAILS.

notes.template_hint_policy: For column-disambiguation the template MUST have NO bbox_hint on the Receiver field. Otherwise the spatial anchor makes the test trivially pass and provides no regression value. Configure OCR_E2E_REGRESSION_TEMPLATE to point to a template that satisfies this.
notes.v1_extract_bypass_warning: This suite MUST run through the UI harness. /api/v1/extract skips the client-side PDF→3600px PNG conversion — different bytes reach the model. Do not point this suite at v1/extract.
